actions: Deploy NAS sequence number validation with a rolling window of 1000.
Enforce EEA4 ciphering integrity checks against known IMSI groups.
Implement NAS trace rate limiting at 5 requests/minute per IMSI.
Enable RRC connection rejections for NAS with nested_field1_unmaskedvalue > 180.
Configure core to drop NAS with nas-eps_seq_no_value < 1000.
Add NAS rule to flag EEA4 ciphering mismatches in real-time.
Deploy NAS anomaly detection with 99.9% false-positive threshold.
Update RAN to enforce NAS trace logging for all EEA4 ciphering attempts.
Set NAS trace retention timer to 24 hours for forensic analysis.
